// Translated by CodeBreaker from InnerOuter (java).
public class InnerOuter
{
    public InnerOuter()
    {
    }

    internal int count = 3;

    internal class Counter
    {
        internal Counter(InnerOuter outer_arg)
        {
            outer_ = outer_arg;
        }

        internal virtual int twice()
        {
            return outer_.count * 2;
        }

        internal InnerOuter outer_;
    }

    internal static int plain(int x)
    {
        return x + 1;
    }
}
